description: This file contains the implementation of the RateReadService interface, providing methods to retrieve rate data from the database, such as all rates, specific rate by ID or name, and applicable rates for loans. It uses JdbcTemplate for database interactions and includes a nested RowMapper class for mapping SQL query results to RateData objects.

classes.name: RateReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of RateReadService providing database access methods for rate data.

classes.name: RateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to RateData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllRates
methods.description: Fetches all rate records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single rate by its unique ID, throws RateNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: retrieveByName
methods.description: Retrieves a rate based on its name, throws RateNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableRates
methods.description: Fetches all active rates applicable to loans.

methods.name: retrieveLoanRates
methods.description: Retrieves rates associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveProductLoanRates
methods.description: Retrieves rates associated with a specific product loan ID.
